versioned_evaluator_repair.fault_owner: Our post-evaluation assertion, not a tracker, model or upstream evaluator bug
versioned_evaluator_repair.incorrect_assertion: Identical per-frame detections imply identical DetA, LocA and CLEAR FP/FN across all public-ID trajectories
versioned_evaluator_repair.primary_source_explanation: Pinned HOTA weights per-frame matching by global ID alignment; CLEAR prioritizes continuity with previously matched IDs. Different public-ID trajectories can therefore yield different matched detections and derived detection/localization metrics despite identical geometric input
versioned_evaluator_repair.repair_scope: Evaluator and independent detection-multiset validator/tests only
versioned_evaluator_repair.replacement_guard: Exact per-frame exported multiset of (frame,x,y,width,height,confidence), excluding public identity and row ordering; preserve multiplicity, validate finite positive geometry and unique public IDs per frame. Retain existing trace candidate-UID and complete-frame-axis checks
